positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description: Completed an Angular web application which allows researchers to quickly obtain information about various potentially cancerous genomic malformations.  Final application (the SMART Cancer Navigator) currently in use at the Boston Children’s Hospital, co-authored paper published in the Journal of Clinical Oncology.

positions.title: Software Lead
positions.description:
Designed motion profiling algorithms, computer vision (OpenCV/Vuforia) pipelines, and autonomous scoring routines in Java, as well as C++ via the Java Native Interface.
Advanced to the State, Regional, and World championships over subsequent seasons.
